result.title: Grounding in the Dark: Text-Only Training for Zero-Shot Video Temporal Localization
result.summary: Video-LLMs are typically trained on paired video-text data for temporal tasks, yet collecting precise temporal annotations and training on large-scale video datasets are both costly. We investigate whether a text-only LLM, with no vision-language pretraining, can be trained on textual video descriptions alone to perform temporal grounding and receive video only at inference time. This setting removes paired video data from training altogether and is a step toward training multimodal models without paired annotations. We generate a 134K-example corpus of textual sequences with up to 100 time steps, adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA on CLIP or LLM2CLIP text embeddings, and evaluate on Charades-STA and QV-Highlights without training on videos from either benchmark. LLM2CLIP, whose text encoder supports longer inputs, represents detailed descriptions better than CLIP (61.54 versus 53.86 mtIoU on Temporal-TextVid) and transfers them better to video. Still, replacing text with frame embeddings at inference yields only 4.99 mtIoU on Charades-STA and 11.12 on QV-Highlights, revealing a large modality gap. To bridge it, we propose Nearest Entity Replacement (NER), a training-free mapping that represents each video frame by the normalized mean of its nearest text-entity embeddings, so that the model receives the kind of input it was trained on. NER reaches 14.45 mtIoU on Charades-STA and 20.72 on QV-Highlights, outperforming the strongest of four families of modality-gap baselines by 5.00 and 1.71 points. NER thus enables partial transfer from text to video, while more reliable grounding will likely require encoders with better-aligned text and visual representations.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作研究只用文本视频描述训练一个无视觉预训练的 LLM 做零样本视频时序定位：构造 134K 文本序列语料，用 LoRA 适配 Qwen3-8B 到 CLIP/LLM2CLIP 文本嵌入，并提出免训练的 Nearest Entity Replacement，用最近文本实体嵌入的归一化均值表示每一帧，以缩小推理时的模态鸿沟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心是文本嵌入空间与视觉帧嵌入的错位及免训练映射，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何映射到语言表示空间、在无配对监督下筛选证据提供一条可供核查的方法线索，但不涉及 latent 推理状态生成或停止决策，故只作方法借鉴。
